# preprocessing.exog_providers.build_providers_from_config { #spotforecast2_safe.preprocessing.exog_providers.build_providers_from_config }

```python
preprocessing.exog_providers.build_providers_from_config(
    config,
    *,
    data_home=None,
)
```

Construct providers by reading the registry flags off a config object.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                                                             | Description                                                                                                                       | Default    |
|-----------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| config    | [Union](`typing.Union`)\[\'ConfigEntsoe\', \'ConfigMulti\', [object](`object`)\] | A config object (e.g. ``ConfigEntsoe`` / ``ConfigMulti``) whose attributes include the :data:`EXOG_PROVIDER_REGISTRY` flag names. | _required_ |
| data_home | [DataHome](`spotforecast2_safe.preprocessing.exog_providers.DataHome`)           | Root data directory forwarded to each provider.                                                                                   | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                                                                  | Description                                                           |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [List](`typing.List`)\[[ExogFeatureProvider](`spotforecast2_safe.preprocessing.exog_providers.ExogFeatureProvider`)\] | List[ExogFeatureProvider]: Providers for the flags set to ``True`` on |
|        | [List](`typing.List`)\[[ExogFeatureProvider](`spotforecast2_safe.preprocessing.exog_providers.ExogFeatureProvider`)\] | *config*.                                                             |
